title: Banking Sector Reforms In India Basel Norms
definition: Banking sector reforms in India encompass structural, operational, and regulatory changes initiated post-1991 to enhance financial stability, efficiency, and competitiveness, heavily anchored in international capital adequacy standards known as Basel Accords formulated by the Basel Committee on Banking Supervision (BCBS).
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for UPSC CSE Prelims (RBI guidelines, Capital to Risk-Weighted Assets Ratio [CRAR], Basel III parameters, Prompt Corrective Action [PCA]) and Mains GS Paper III (Indian Economy, mobilization of resources, growth, development, and banking sector vulnerability/NPAs).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Banking Sector Reforms In India Basel Norms.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Basic understanding of commercial banking operations, assets, liabilities, and Non-Performing Assets (NPAs).
